[2026-08-27T21:42:06.720Z] [world] You've left Nimari and entered The Monarch's Waystation. The seneschal logs your name without asking it. The Monarchs' ledgers have their ways. It's morning. Halem the Trader is the only soul in sight. east leads to Dynasty Border Post; west leads to Iskan-Veil. Nothing named to the north or south.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.720Z] [world] You pass through the gate into Monarch Court — The Atrium. Polished mud-glass tiles and a carved Monarch sigil over the doorway. The seneschal nods you through without speaking — your business has already been logged elsewhere.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.721Z] [world] You have been here. The shape of it comes back before the details do.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.721Z] [world] Paths: north to Standards · south to First Landing. (Type 'leave outpost' to head into the wilds.)
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.721Z] [system] Weather effect — Black Rain: -1 CHA
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.721Z] [world] Halem the Trader places you as you come in. "Great Scott. What are you after?"
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.722Z] [world] "Been a while," Halem the Trader says. "Thought the mud had you."
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.722Z] [debug] arbiter: template (reason=qwen-not-ready)
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.722Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter eyes one corner of The Monarch's Waystation. "Begin there, if you must begin somewhere."
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.728Z] [reward] ✦ Faction contract complete — A Seat at the Table. +60 TC, +8 rep with Mud Monarchs.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.770Z] [reward] ✦ You've earned dealing with the Mud Monarchs. From now their vendors cut you the partner's rate — currently 2% off buys and +2% on sell-backs (it grows with your Charisma).
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.771Z] [system] Word moves through the buried world — many people view you differently now.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.771Z] [arbiter] Word will travel that you finished this clean. The next thread will find you.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.771Z] [world] A stranger in a clean coat is waiting at the outpost, and he quotes your remaining balance to the disc — then offers to clear it, whole, for what rides in your pack. He has done the sums too. You decline without a word, and watch him understand, slowly, that the debt is no longer the biggest number in your life.
[2026-08-27T21:42:06.772Z] [world] It is as thin as it gets. Whatever you are still carrying is worth more than what anybody will sell you.
[2026-08-27T21:42:10.578Z] [arbiter] You do not give a reason. She does not need one and does not ask, only rolls the writ back around the Aetherstone with the ease of somebody who has done it a hundred times and will do it a hundred more. "Then it stays yours
," she says. "All of it. That is not the compliment people think it is."
